title: HR Coordinator
description:
**Job Description**
 At IPS, we are global leaders in developing innovative solutions for the consulting, architecture, engineering, project controls, procurement, construction management, and CQV of technically complex facilities, primarily in the life sciences industry. We are looking for a talented
 **HR Assistant** 
 to join our dedicated team at our office in
 **Vikhroli, Mumbai** 
 .
   

  

 Position Responsibilities
   

  

 Recruitment \& Onboarding
   

  

* Assist in sourcing candidates and scheduling interviews.
* Coordinate candidate communications and interviews.
* Support pre\-employment documentation and background verification processes.
* Prepare offer letters and onboarding documentation.
* Facilitate new hire orientation and induction activities.


 HR Operations \& Administration
   

  

* Maintain and update employee records in HR systems.
* Manage employee files and ensure data accuracy and confidentiality.
* Support attendance, leave, and employee data management.
* Assist in preparing HR reports and dashboards.
* Coordinate employee confirmation, transfers, and exit processes.


 Employee Support
   

  

* Respond to employee queries regarding HR policies, benefits, and procedures.
* Support employee engagement activities and wellness initiatives.
* Assist in organizing company events, training sessions, and meetings.


 Compliance \& Documentation
   

  

* Ensure compliance with company policies and labor regulations.
* Maintain HR documentation, forms, and records.
* Assist in audits and compliance\-related activities.


**Qualifications \& Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 2\-4 years of experience in HR administration or HR support roles.
* Freshers with relevant internships may also apply.


**About Us**
 IPS, a Berkshire Hathaway company, is a global leader in technical consulting, architecture, engineering, procurement, construction management, commissioning, qualification, and validation services for technically complex facilities. Integration is how we think and work. It requires the ability to unite existing and emerging technologies into a process that reliably delivers products and accelerates speed to market. That end\-to\-end mindset allows us to be agile and anticipate challenges as we move projects toward operational readiness. IPS applies design and delivery expertise, client\-side experience, and supplier\-side insight to every project. We infuse our curiosity, our passion, and our commitment to partnership in delivering solutions at any scale. We meet our clients where they are and get them to where they need to go. That’s only possible when we care as much as our clients do.
   

  

 Specialties
   

  

 Process Architecture, Process Design, Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Qualification, LEAN Project Delivery, Strategic Master Planning, Energy Conservation Management, Project Controls, Program/Project Management, Operations/Logistics Strategy and Planning, EPCMV, and Staffing Services.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment at IPS without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic predisposition or carrier status, veteran, marital, or citizenship status; or any other status protected by law. IPS is proud to be an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer.
   

  

*Attention Search Firms/Third\-Party Recruiters: IPS is not seeking assistance or accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for employment opportunities with IPS. Regardless of past practice, all resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at IPS via email, the Internet, or directly to hiring managers at IPS in any form without a valid written search agreement in place for a specific position will be deemed the sole property of IPS, and no fee will be paid in the event a candidate is hired by IPS as a result of the referral or through other means.*
 Connect With Us!
   

  

 If you do not meet the qualifications for this specific role, but would like to submit your resume for general consideration, please click here!

title: Assignment Support Coordinator (HR)
description:

**Location** 
 – Mumbai
 



 Join Our Team as an Assignment Support Coordinator at NES Fircroft!

 Following up on flagged issues and collaborating with consultants to resolve them.
 



 Creating ad hoc reports and maintaining spreadsheets for client needs.
 



 Ensuring 100% compliance in monthly audits.

 Collaborating with Commercial, Payroll, and Travel teams to ensure smooth contractor experiences.
 



 Support regional Assignment Support teams when needed.
 



 Escalating issues to the Team Leader or Manager when appropriate.
 



 Reporting Bullhorn issues and workload delays promptly.

 Coordinating visa requests with the PRO team.
 



 Ensuring timely visa applications and researching requirements for new regions.
 



**What We’re Looking For** 




**Experienced:** 
 Preferably with a background in customer\-facing roles.
 



**Tech\-Savvy:** 
 Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.
 



**Professional** 
 : Strong communication skills in English and Arabic, with a polished demeanor.
 



**Organized:** 
 Excellent time management and multitasking abilities.
 



**Proactive:** 
 Resourceful and quick to resolve issues.
 



**Customer\-Focused:** 
 A positive, service\-oriented attitude.
 



**Qualified:** 
 Preferably holding a bachelor's degree.
 



**Why NES Fircroft?** 




**Competitive Salary \& Bonus Scheme** 
 – Rewarding your dedication and performance.
 



**Work From Home** 
 – Enjoy flexibility with one remote day per week.
 



**Charity Participation** 
 – Make a difference through community involvement.
 



**Career Progression** 
 – Clear paths for growth and advancement.
 



**Life Insurance** 
 – Comprehensive coverage for peace of mind.
 



**Early Finish Fridays** 
 – Start your weekend early with a 4pm wrap\-up.
 



**Lively Work Environment** 
 – A fun, energetic team culture.
 



**Achiever Club**

title: Human Resource Associate
description:
Human Resource Associate
 
**Location:** 
 Powai, Mumbai
 



**Company:** 
 DJRS Hospitality LLP
 



**Department:** 
 Human Resources
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Experience:** 
 0–2 Years
 



**Reports To:** 
 HR Manager / Head of Human Resources
 


 About DJRS Hospitality LLP
 
 DJRS Hospitality LLP is a growing hospitality company building and operating a diverse portfolio of restaurants, cafés, cloud kitchens, catering, events, and experiential concepts across Mumbai.
 



 As we continue to grow, we are looking for an enthusiastic and organised
 **Human Resource Associate** 
 to join our HR team and gain hands\-on exposure to various aspects of Human Resources.
 



 This is a great opportunity for a
 **fresher or an early\-career HR professional** 
 who wants to build a strong foundation in HR while working in a fast\-paced hospitality environment.
 


 About the Role
 
 As a Human Resource Associate, you will support the HR team across
 **recruitment, onboarding, HR administration, employee engagement, payroll coordination, employee queries, documentation, and day\-to\-day HR operations.** 




 You will work closely with the HR team, employees, HODs, outlet managers, Finance, and Operations, giving you practical exposure to the complete employee lifecycle.
 



 We are looking for someone who is
 **eager to learn, comfortable interacting with people, organised with their work, and willing to take ownership as they grow into the role.** 



 Key ResponsibilitiesRecruitment \& Hiring
 * Assist with end\-to\-end recruitment for various corporate and operational positions.
* Understand hiring requirements shared by HODs and reporting managers.
* Prepare and post Job Descriptions on LinkedIn, Indeed, and other recruitment platforms.
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals, databases, and other channels.
* Screen CVs and shortlist candidates based on role requirements.
* Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers.
* Follow up with candidates regarding interviews, assignments, feedback, and joining timelines.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and provide regular hiring updates.
* Assist with offer rollouts and pre\-joining coordination.
* Support recruitment requirements for new outlets and pre\-opening projects.


 Joining \& Onboarding
 * Coordinate joining formalities for new employees and interns.
* Collect and maintain required employee documents.
* Update employee information in HR records and systems.
* Assist in conducting employee induction and orientation programmes.
* Support employee transfers, promotions, increments, and other employee movements.
* Maintain records of new joiners, active employees, and resigned employees.
* Assist with exit formalities and Full \& Final Settlement documentation.


 HR Operations \& Payroll Support
 * Assist with monthly payroll preparation and coordination with Finance.
* Update attendance, salary, deductions, incentives, increments, and other payroll inputs.
* Assist in preparing salary working and payout sheets.
* Support service charge\-related workings and employee data.
* Assist employees with basic queries related to salary, payslips, attendance, leave, and other HR matters.
* Maintain employee registers, trackers, and HR records.
* Assist with HRMS and payroll systems such as Facto HR.
* Support the HR team with PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, and other statutory documentation and requirements.


 Employee Relations \& Engagement
 * Act as a point of contact for employees for routine HR\-related queries.
* Assist in resolving employee concerns by coordinating with the appropriate HR or operational stakeholders.
* Interact with employees and outlet teams to understand their concerns and requirements.
* Assist in organising employee engagement activities and celebrations.
* Support Employee of the Month and employee recognition initiatives.
* Assist with outlet visits and employee interactions when required.


 HR Administration \& Documentation
 * Prepare and maintain HR documents such as offer letters, increment letters, warning letters, certificates, and other employee documentation.
* Maintain accurate and organised employee files and HR records.
* Assist with employment verification and other employee\-related documentation.
* Support HR policy communication and distribution.
* Maintain leave, attendance, and employee movement records.
* Handle employee information with confidentiality and professionalism.


 HR Systems \& Process Support
 * Maintain HR trackers, employee masters, and reporting sheets.
* Work with
 **MS Excel and Google Sheets** 
 for day\-to\-day HR activities.
* Assist in maintaining and improving HR trackers and templates.
* Support the HR team in implementing simple process improvements and automations.
* Learn and work with HRMS and other digital HR tools.
* Prepare basic HR reports and data for internal review.


 What We're Looking For
 
 We are looking for someone who is:
 


* Eager to build a career in Human Resources.
* Comfortable communicating with people at different levels.
* Organised and attentive to detail.
* Comfortable working with numbers, spreadsheets, and employee data.
* Willing to learn new HR systems and processes.
* Proactive and willing to take responsibility for assigned tasks.
* Good at following up and ensuring tasks are completed on time.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced hospitality environment.
* Professional, approachable, and able to maintain confidentiality.
* A team player with a positive and learning\-oriented attitude.


 Qualifications \& Experience
 * Bachelor's degree in
 **Human Resources, Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or a related field.**
* Freshers are welcome to apply.
* Candidates with
 **0–2 years of experience** 
 in HR, recruitment, administration, hospitality, retail, or a similar environment are encouraged to apply.
* HR internships or academic exposure to recruitment, payroll, employee engagement, or HR operations will be an advantage.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel, Google Sheets, and MS Office.
* Prior exposure to any HRMS or recruitment platform will be an advantage.
* Basic understanding of HR processes and employee lifecycle will be preferred.


 Why Join DJRS Hospitality?
 * Build hands\-on experience across multiple areas of Human Resources.
* Learn recruitment, HR operations, payroll coordination, employee relations, and HR administration.
* Gain exposure to a growing hospitality organisation and multiple brands.
* Work closely with experienced HR and operational teams.
* Develop practical skills in Excel, Google Sheets, HRMS, and HR processes.
* Opportunity to take on greater responsibilities as you grow.
* Employee engagement initiatives and a people\-focused work environment.
* Learning and development opportunities.
* Career growth within the DJRS Hospitality group.


 Apply Now
 
 If you are starting your HR career and are looking for a role where you can
 **learn, contribute, and grow through real hands\-on experience** 
 , we'd love to hear from you.
 



**Email:** 
 hr@djrshospitality.com
 



**Subject:** 
 Human Resource Associate – Application
 



**Experience isn't everything. We are looking for someone with the right attitude, willingness to learn, and the drive to grow with the team.**

title: SAP ERP Human Resource (HR) : Payroll
description:
TCS VIRTUAL INTERVIEW FOR THE BELOW SKILL:
 



  





 SKILL: SAP ERP Human Resource (HR): Payroll
 



  





 LOCATION: MUMBAI
 



  





 EXP: 6\-8 YRS
 



  





 SAP HR Payroll Support Executive with hands\-on experience in SAP HCM Payroll support, payroll processing, incident management, and employee data administration. The candidate will be responsible for supporting payroll operations, resolving payroll\-related issues, maintaining HR master data, and ensuring compliance with payroll policies and statutory requirements. The role involves working closely with HR, Finance, and business stakeholders in a support environment. The responsibilities and skills are aligned with SAP HCM Payroll, Personnel Administration, Organizational Management, and payroll operations support practices found in enterprise profiles and SAP HCM payroll consultant requirements.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Provide L1/L2 support for SAP HCM Payroll incidents and service requests.
* Monitor payroll processing and resolve payroll\-related issues.
* Support employee master data maintenance in SAP HR.
* Handle payroll validation, data corrections, and reconciliation activities.
* Support Personnel Administration (PA), Organizational Management (OM), Time Management (TM), and Payroll modules.
* Coordinate with HR, Finance, and business teams for payroll execution.
* Investigate payroll errors and perform root cause analysis.
* Support month\-end and year\-end payroll activities.
* Prepare reports and documentation related to payroll operations.
* Ensure compliance with statutory and organizational payroll policies.

title: Corporate Human Resources Manager
description:
**CORPORATE HR MANAGER / DOHR** 




 📍
 **Location: Mumbai** 




**About the Opportunity** 




 Strategic Management Alliance is hiring a
 **Corporate HR Manager / Director of HR (DOHR)** 
 on behalf of a leading organization engaged in delivering large\-scale, high\-quality catering and inflight services while maintaining stringent standards of food safety, quality, operational excellence and customer satisfaction. The vertical is part of a leading
 **Hospitality Organisation.** 




 The position will
 **assist the CHRO in overseeing all HR functions across the organization,** 
 ensuring effective implementation of HR strategies, policies and processes in alignment with business objectives.
 



 The role will have a strong focus on HR analytics, budgeting, dynamic manpower planning and headcount assessment, with particular emphasis on evaluating workforce requirements and costs in relation to the P\&L of individual business units as well as the overall entity.
 



 This is an opportunity for an experienced HR professional to work closely with senior leadership, strengthen HR systems and processes, and support business performance through effective workforce planning and people management.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Corporate HR \& CHRO Support** 



* Assist the CHRO in overseeing and coordinating all HR functions across the organization.
* Support the development and implementation of HR strategies, policies and organizational initiatives.
* Partner with business heads and senior management to address HR priorities and organizational requirements.



**HR Analytics, Budgeting \& Manpower Planning** 



* Drive HR analytics and provide meaningful insights to support management decision\-making.
* Coordinate annual HR budgeting, manpower planning and periodic workforce cost reviews.
* Undertake dynamic headcount assessment based on business requirements, operational needs and financial performance.
* Monitor manpower costs, productivity and workforce deployment across individual business units and the overall entity.
* Analyse HR costs and headcount in relation to the P\&L of each unit as well as the consolidated entity.
* Identify opportunities for workforce optimization, improved productivity and effective utilization of human resources.



**Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning** 



* Coordinate with business heads to assess manpower requirements and ensure timely recruitment.
* Support workforce forecasting, talent pipeline development and succession planning.
* Ensure recruitment plans remain aligned with approved budgets and business priorities.



**Performance Management \& Talent Development** 



* Coordinate performance management and appraisal processes across the organization.
* Support talent development, leadership capability building and employee career progression.
* Work with business leaders to identify training needs and implement relevant development initiatives.



**Employee Engagement \& HR Operations** 



* Drive employee engagement, retention and organizational culture initiatives.
* Support employee relations and resolution of workplace concerns.
* Ensure effective HR operations, employee documentation and personnel processes.



**HR Policies \& Statutory Compliance** 



* Support the implementation and periodic review of HR policies and procedures.
* Ensure adherence to applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Maintain appropriate HR records, analytics, MIS and compliance documentation.



**Preferred Candidate Profile** 



* Graduate in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related discipline.
* MBA / Post\-Graduate qualification in Human Resources will be an advantage.
* **12\-15 years HR Experience in reputed Hospitality Organisations ; Unit Head of HR exposure in Hotel Industry** 
 or Relevant experience in Regional / Corporate HR, would be ideal.
* Strong understanding of
 **HR analytics, manpower budgeting, workforce planning and headcount management.**

 **MIS, workforce productivity analysis and management reporting** 
 .
* Strong understanding of HR operations, talent acquisition, performance management and employee engagement.
* Excellent analytical, communication, stakeholder management and problem\-solving skills.

title: Market People & Culture Manager
description:
**WHO YOU ARE** 




  





 As a person you are passionate about people, business, IKEA’s purpose and continuously driving better performance. You are energized by increasing customer value, driving business growth and contributing to overall success and results through people as well as motivated by leading and developing people.
   

 For this role you have University degree and 15\+ years of related experience.
 



  





**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





 • Oversee People \& Culture (P\&C/ Human Resources) responsibilities for the assigned market comprising of all the IKEA units spanning between Mumbai and Pune.
   

 • Secure consistent execution of people processes, frameworks and initiatives across the market.
   

 • Lead, coach and develop the Unit P\&C teams for securing a high\-performing People \& Culture function across the market.
   

 • Partner with the Market Manager and the Leadership teams in driving the people agenda to support consistent coworker experience, business growth, operational excellence and expansion.
   

 • Collaborate with the business leaders to identify current and future workforce needs and secure effective workforce planning, recruitment and retention.
   

 • Lead talent and succession planning across the market and support leaders in identifying, developing and retaining diverse talent.
   

 • Coach and support the leaders on effective implementation of people processes with focus on performance management, leadership development, organizational effectiveness, co\-worker engagement, change management and Total Rewards.
   

 • Drive Equity, Diversity and Inclusion priorities for the market with strong focus on maintaining the defined gender balance, and an inclusive workplace for all coworkers.
   

 • Manage and oversee matters of labour compliances, concerns and appeals, disciplinary matters and related areas of coworker relations with support from the Coworker Relations expert.
   

 • Partner with business leaders in creating and sustaining a psychologically safe work environment in the market.
   

 • Manage and oversee employer branding activities in the market with support from the Employer branding country team.
   

 • Lead and drive initiatives of organizational changes and business transformation from people perspective including overall change management and strong internal communication.
   

 • Act as the key People \& Culture partner and escalation point within the market, collaborating closely with Market Area P\&C Manager, Centres of Expertise Manger and P\&C Location Operational Services Manager to deliver business results.
 



  





**TOGETHER AS A TEAM** 




  





 To support the management of the organization’s people and culture. Activities included enveloping people and culture management strategies and policies to meet business needs; planning, administering and reviewing activities concerned with recruitment, training and development, compensation and benefits, mobility, talent acquisition, diversity, talent management \& organization development and co\-worker relations.  This India \& AMET (Africa, Middle east and Turkey) Rewards Lead is a senior, strategic position based in Mumbai, designed to address the growing complexity and ambition of the rewards agenda across India and the AMET region (Including Tunisia, Egypt, Turkey, KSA and UAE countries). This role drives also the transformational projects shaping the future of rewards at OPELLA India, and operates at the intersection of strategic advisory, transformation leadership, and operational excellence across a broad and diverse geography.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
 This position plays a pivotal role in leading and elevating the OPELLA Rewards strategy across India and the AMET region, with a particular focus on driving transformational change initiatives, ensuring regulatory compliance as a listed entity, and providing senior\-level strategic guidance to the India P\&C Director, Leadership Team, and AMET business and HR leaders.

 Oversee and drive operational excellence across all rewards and performance activities for India \& AMET, including:

Provide data\-driven insights through dashboards and reporting tools to support leadership decision\-making.

title: Human Resources Consultant
description:
We're looking for an HR / OD Consultant. But not the "write a policy manual" kind.
 



 This is a 4\-month project assignment. It is not a permanent position.
 



  





 At SHANBHAGS, we are in the middle of an important internal transformation.
 



 The vision is clear. The intent is clear. Now comes the harder part: making it real.
 



 Because organisations do not change because a presentation says they should. They change when intent translates into clear behaviours, operating disciplines, systems and SOPs that people can actually follow — and managers can actually manage.
 



  





 We are looking for a senior HR / Organisation Development Consultant who has done this before — at scale. Someone who can understand the organisation, work closely with leadership and employees, and help build the frameworks and SOPs that make the transformation live every day.
 



 Not just define what should happen. Design it. Implement it. Make it stick.
 



  





 You should bring:
 


* 10–15\+ years of serious HR / OD experience
* Proven experience designing AND successfully implementing organisation\-wide SOPs, operating frameworks and people/culture systems
* Experience working with large and complex organisations
* Ability to translate organisational intent into specific, practical, measurable and repeatable behaviours and processes
* Strong experience across performance management, capability building, accountability, leadership, cross\-functional working, employee development and culture implementation
* The ability to work with leadership while understanding what actually happens on the ground
* A healthy intolerance for beautifully written documents that collapse the minute real life begins



 One thing matters enormously: You must have implemented what you designed.
 



  





 This is not recruitment. Not an HR audit. Not policy polishing. And certainly not another employee handbook nobody reads. It is about helping us build the operating DNA for the next phase of Shanbhag Engineering Company.
 



  





 We also welcome former CHROs, HR Heads and senior OD leaders who may have stepped away from full\-time corporate life but still enjoy solving difficult organisational problems. Perhaps you no longer want the title or a 9\-to\-9 — but still miss rolling up your sleeves once in a while. For someone like that, this could be a very satisfying four months — a chance to solve a real organisational problem and build something that lasts well beyond the assignment.
 



  





 Interested? Write directly to hr@shanbhags.com with:
 


* A brief profile and relevant work experience
* One organisation\-wide system / transformation you designed and successfully implemented
* Your expected professional fee for the 4\-month assignment



  





 Learn more about us at https://shanbhags.com

**Company Description** 
 Subko Specialty Coffee Roasters, Bakehouse and Fine Cacao is a purpose\-driven brand spotlighting specialty coffee, elevated baking, and fine cacao from the Indian Subcontinent. The company combines traditional “daily bread” culture with innovative, risk\-taking flavor profiles, crafting distinctive coffees, breads, viennoiserie, and cacao products. Subko’s mission is to build a genuinely Asian specialty coffee and cacao movement and represent the region on a global platform. Through a “Cherry to Cup,” “Crop to Craft,” and “Pod to Bar” ethos, Subko focuses on meticulous sourcing, processing, and production to set new quality standards. The team is driven by craft, curiosity, and a commitment to reshaping how people experience coffee, bakehouse offerings, and cacao.

 The Learning and Development Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Mumbai, responsible for designing and leading learning initiatives across Subko’s coffee, bakehouse, and cacao operations. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include creating training curricula, facilitating workshops and on\-the\-job training, managing learning content and systems, and partnering with managers to build role\-specific capabilities. The Learning and Development Manager will collaborate closely with leadership to develop talent pipelines, support performance and leadership development, and ensure training aligns with Subko’s craft\-focused culture and growth plans. * Candidates should possess skills in Leadership Development to support manager capability\-building, succession planning, and talent growth.

* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management abilities, with a collaborative, hands\-on working style.
* Proven experience in a Learning and Development or similar HR role, preferably 4–7 years, with responsibility for end\-to\-end training programs.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Education, Business, Psychology, or a related field; relevant certifications in L\&D or instructional design are an advantage.

title: Process Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 The candidate must possess in\-depth functional knowledge of HR processes and apply it to operational scenarios to provide effective solutions. The candidate must be able to identify discrepancies and propose optimal solutions by using a logical, systematic, and sequential methodology. It is vital to be open\-minded towards inputs and views from team members and to effectively lead, control, and motivate groups towards company’s vision. Additionally, the candidate must be self\-directed, proactive and seize every opportunity to meet internal and external customer needs and achieve customer satisfaction by effectively auditing processes, implementing best people practices and process improvements, and utilizing the frameworks and tools available. Goals and thoughts must be clearly and concisely articulated and conveyed, verbally and in writing, to clients, colleagues, subordinates, and supervisors. The candidate should act as a change agent, acting as a catalyst to drive vertical/org. level changes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Employee Engagement \& Issue Resolution
   

  

* Understand employee pulse through regular connects and raise concerns to the right stakeholders.
* Ensure employee issues are resolved end\-to\-end with quick turnaround.
* Conduct one\-on\-one connects with the Analyst–Manager pool during pulse checks.
* Govern leadership connect sessions for the program.
* Manage attrition for the program and implement retention actions.


 Performance Management
   

  

* Partner with Business for performance calibration discussions.
* Conduct sessions to educate employees on the Performance Management System.
* Ensure timely goal\-setting between managers and their teams.
* Guide and train managers on the evaluation process.
* Monitor and govern PIP/Performance Coaching for bottom performers.
* Close calibration cycles with Business.


 Career \& Capability Development
   

  

* Run career development and capability\-building programs for identified A–PM talent.
* Coach employees to take ownership of their growth.
* Oversee the 90\-day onboarding and assimilation journey for Analyst–Manager pool.


 Discipline \& Compliance
   

  

* Investigate any conduct\-related issues and close them with appropriate disciplinary action when required.
* Complete exit interviews for Analyst–Process Manager employees within timelines.
* Ensure timely closure of Bottom Quartile cases.
* Close background verification issues for Analyst–Process Manager employees in the program.


 Reporting \& Governance
   

  

* Keep all trackers updated, including pulse, discipline, conduct, and performance.
* Share updated trackers with the Senior HRBP and other stakeholders.
* Create and maintain reports and dashboards for all program\-related HR activities.
* Drive Rewards \& Recognition programs to appreciate employee contributions and boost performance.


**Qualifications**
* Graduate with an MBA
* 5\+ years of total experience, with at least 3 years as an HR Business Partner in a KPO / IT / ITES environment
* Strong understanding of HR processes like performance management, employee engagement, attrition management, and capability development
* Experience handling employee relations, grievance resolution, and disciplinary processes
* Ability to work closely with business leaders and manage stakeholder expectations
* Good communication, analytical, and reporting skills
* Comfortable managing multiple priorities and driving HR initiatives end\-to\-end.


**Shift Timing:** 
 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM

**Technical Excellence**
* Strong expertise in talent transformation initiatives, translating workforce needs into actionable advisory solutions.  Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market\-leading growth over competitors.  Fairmont Hotels \& Resorts is where the intimate equally coexists with the infinite – an unrivaled portfolio of more than 90 extraordinary hotels where grand moments of life, heartfelt pleasures and personal milestones are celebrated and remembered long after any visit. Since 1907, Fairmont has created magnificent, meaningful and unforgettable hotels, rich with character and deeply connected to the history, culture and community of its destinations – places such as The Plaza in New York City, The Savoy in London, Fairmont San Francisco, Fairmont Banff Springs in Canada, Fairmont Peace Hotel in Shanghai, and Fairmont The Palm in Dubai. Famous for its engaging service, awe\-inspiring public spaces, locally inspired cuisine, and iconic bars and lounges, Fairmont also takes great pride in its pioneering approach to hospitality and leadership in sustainability and responsible tourism practices. Fairmont is part of Accor, a world leading hospitality group counting over 5,400 properties throughout more than 110 countries, and a participating brand in ALL \- Accor Live Limitless – a lifestyle loyalty program providing access to a wide variety of rewards, services and experiences.

 , while supporting business objectives and fostering a high\-performance culture.
   

  

 The incumbent will act as a strategic partner to the General Manager and Executive Committee, driving employee engagement, talent development, and operational excellence.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide strategic HR support to the Executive Committee.
* Drive organizational development, workforce planning, and change management initiatives.
* Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning
* Oversee recruitment and selection processes to ensure timely hiring of qualified candidates.
* Ensure adherence to approved manning budgets and organizational structure.
* Promote employer branding initiatives in line with Accor standards.

* Implement training plans and development programs in line with Accor learning frameworks.
* Monitor training effectiveness and ensure compliance with mandatory training requirements.
* Identify high\-potential employees and support succession planning.

* Support department heads in goal setting, performance reviews, and development planning.
* Promote a performance\-driven culture with clear accountability.
* Employee Engagement \& Welfare
* Drive employee engagement initiatives to enhance satisfaction and retention.
* Ensure effective communication channels across all levels of the organization.
* Oversee employee welfare activities in line with company policies.
* Compensation \& Benefits
* Ensure proper administration of payroll, benefits, and statutory compliance.
* Maintain internal equity and external competitiveness of compensation structures.
* Monitor labor costs in line with budget guidelines.
* Employee Relations \& Compliance
* Manage employee relations issues, including grievances and disciplinary matters.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labor laws and Accor policies.
* Maintain positive relations with external authorities and stakeholders where required.
* HR Operations \& Administration
* Oversee HR administration, documentation, and record management.
* Ensure compliance with internal audits and corporate reporting requirements.
* Maintain HR systems and ensure data accuracy.

* Ensure implementation of Accor values and Heartist® culture across both properties.
* Support the integration of brand standards for Fairmont and Morgans Originals into daily operations.
* Promote a culture of professionalism, respect, and continuous improvement.

 Additional Information

 Assistant Manager \- Client Servicing

 5\-6\+ Years

* Manage and collect client payments.
* Agreement renewal \& negotiations

* Strong coordination and follow\-up abilities
* Good understanding of staffing/manpower operations

* Problem\-solving and negotiation skills
* Ability to manage multiple clients and priorities
* Willingness to travel for client visits

* Gain experience in world class management practices
* Insurance Benefits (Medical and Accidental) for all employees
* Multi\-level Rewards programs for all employees

title: Fleet Personnel Officer
description:
Seaspan employees are goal\-driven and thrive in a high\-performance culture. Our integrated business model, with over 25 years of fleet life\-cycle management expertise, provides the world’s major shipping companies with long\-term leases on large, modern and technologically advanced vessels, combined with industry\-leading ship management services. As owner and operator of the vessels, we provide skilled officers and crews dedicated to the safe, reliable, and economical operation of our fleet. Seaspan's fleet has evolved over time to meet the varying needs of our customer base. We own vessels in a wide range of sizes, from 2,500 TEU to 24,000 TEU. Our main operating offices are located in Singapore, Vancouver, Hong Kong, and Mumbai.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Fleet Personnel Officer provides comprehensive communication, project coordination, executive and administrative support to the Head of Fleet Personnel. The role is responsible for managing high\-volume correspondence, coordinating departmental projects, monitoring actions and deliverables, and supporting the effective functioning of the Head of Fleet Personnel’s office.
   

  

 The position also supports departmental reporting, governance, seafarer welfare initiatives, union and CBA administration, forums, travel and selected operational matters. It requires a high degree of discretion, sound judgement, attention to detail and the ability to remain responsive while coordinating with senior leaders, Fleet Personnel teams, vessels, seafarers, manning partners, unions, vendors and other stakeholders across different time zones.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Email, Communication and Correspondence Management: 20%
* Manage and organise the Head of Fleet Personnel’s high\-volume email correspondence, ensuring messages are reviewed, prioritised and directed appropriately.
* Identify matters requiring immediate attention, follow\-up, delegation or escalation, and maintain visibility of pending responses and commitments.
* Draft, proofread and coordinate emails, letters, memos, presentations and other communications on behalf of the Head of Fleet Personnel.
* Prepare standard departmental letters, invitation letters, confirmations and authorisation documents, and maintain appropriate records.
* Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to obtain timely inputs and ensure correspondence is closed out accurately and professionally.
* Handle confidential, sensitive and privileged information with discretion.
* Project Coordination and Action Management: 20%
* Coordinate Fleet Personnel projects and improvement initiatives by maintaining project plans, milestones, actions, risks, decisions and deliverables.
* Proactively follow up with responsible stakeholders, identify potential delays and provide concise progress updates to the Head of Fleet Personnel.
* Coordinate user inputs, testing, communications and implementation follow\-up for Fleet Personnel systems and digitalisation initiatives, including COMPAS and related crew\-management processes.
* Support the preparation of project briefs, presentations, status reports, process guidance, memos and rollout communications.
* Liaise with IT, Finance, HR, Training, regional teams and other functions to resolve dependencies and support timely delivery.
* Remain responsive to urgent project requirements and changing priorities arising from Seaspan’s global operations.
* Meetings, Minutes and Follow\-up Coordination: 10%
* Coordinate meeting logistics and prepare agendas, briefing notes and supporting materials for departmental, management and external stakeholder meetings.
* Record and circulate clear minutes of meetings and maintain action trackers with owners and target dates.
* Follow up on overdue actions and provide the Head of Fleet Personnel with timely updates on progress and outstanding matters.
* Coordinate the Fleet Personnel weekly meeting agenda and consolidate inputs from departmental and regional teams.
* Support meetings across time zones when operationally required.
* Reporting, Dashboards and Management Information: 10%
* Prepare and maintain periodic reports, dashboards, management information and KPI trackers for the Head of Fleet Personnel.
* Gather and consolidate information from Fleet Personnel teams and company systems into structured summaries for leadership review.
* Support monthly management reporting, budget coordination, variance commentary and ad hoc analysis.
* Maintain accurate records of departmental actions, incidents, recognition, policy exceptions and other agreed metrics.
* Work accurately under tight timelines while managing multiple reporting requirements concurrently.
* CBA, Wage Scale, Vessel Data and Union Coordination: 10%
* Maintain trackers for Collective Bargaining Agreement renewals, vessel enrolments, correspondence and supporting documentation.
* Maintain controlled vessel and CBA data, including business unit, shipowner, flag, complement and applicable wage arrangements.
* Support the preparation, issue and recordkeeping of approved wage scales and related Fleet Personnel memoranda.
* Coordinate routine documentation and follow\-up with unions, manning partners and internal stakeholders under the guidance of the Head of Fleet Personnel.
* Compliance, Audit and Document Control: 8%
* Support ISO, RPSL and other Fleet Personnel audit preparations, including document collection, tracker maintenance and closure of agreed actions.
* Assist with updates to departmental manuals, procedures, records and controlled documents.
* Maintain organised and secure digital and physical filing systems for the Head of Fleet Personnel’s office.
* Ensure records are complete, current, readily retrievable and handled in accordance with company confidentiality and data\-protection requirements.
* Seafarer Welfare, Insurance and Recognition Programmes: 7%
* Coordinate administrative aspects of seafarer medical and life\-insurance programmes, including data updates, supporting documentation and follow\-up with service providers.
* Support humanitarian\-aid and other urgent seafarer welfare arrangements as directed.
* Administer long\-service and loyalty\-recognition programmes, including eligibility records, approved awards, procurement coordination and event logistics.
* Maintain accurate records of recognition items and ensure expenditure remains within approved budgets and processes.
* Forums, Town Halls and Stakeholder Events: 5%
* Support the planning and execution of seafarer forums, vessel town halls, leadership visits, conferences, seminars, roadshows and sponsorship activities.
* Coordinate participant lists, invitations, venues, suppliers, presentation materials, awards and event budgets.
* Liaise with regional offices, vessels, manning partners and internal functions to ensure timely and efficient delivery.
* Maintain event plans, cost trackers, records and post\-event actions.
* Calendar and Travel Coordination: 5%
* Manage the Head of Fleet Personnel’s calendar, including scheduling, prioritising and resolving conflicts across internal and external meetings.
* Anticipate scheduling requirements and ensure adequate preparation time for leadership meetings, operational reviews and external engagements.
* Coordinate domestic and international travel, including flights, accommodation, visas, invitation and coverage letters, ground transport and supporting documentation.
* Prepare and reconcile travel and business expenses through the applicable company expense\-management system.
* Provide timely support when travel arrangements or meeting schedules change outside standard office hours.
* General Departmental and Administrative Support: 5%
* Support vendor onboarding, invoice documentation, purchase coordination and routine departmental administration in accordance with approved processes.
* Coordinate office, equipment and logistical requirements for the Head of Fleet Personnel.
* Respond to routine stakeholder enquiries or direct them to the appropriate responsible person.
* Perform other reasonable duties assigned by the Head of Fleet Personnel in support of departmental priorities.


**Technical Skills**
**Key Skills and Capabilities**
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Teams.
* Strong email organisation, correspondence tracking and action\-management capability.
* Ability to prepare professional correspondence, presentations, reports, dashboards, project plans and structured trackers.
* Strong digital and physical document\-management skills.
* Experience with enterprise systems such as COMPAS or other crew\-management systems, NetSuite, Certify, Concur, SharePoint or similar platforms would be an advantage.
* Ability to work accurately with operational, financial and personnel data.


**Professional Skills**
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* High level of discretion, confidentiality, integrity and professional judgement.
* Strong project coordination, planning, organisation and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work independently, anticipate requirements and manage a high volume of competing priorities.
* Strong attention to detail, responsiveness and consistent follow\-through.
* Ability to engage confidently and respectfully with senior executives, seafarers, vessel teams, unions, manning partners, vendors and colleagues across cultures and time zones.
* Calm, dependable and solution\-oriented approach, particularly when handling urgent or sensitive matters.
* Resilience and the ability to maintain accuracy and professionalism in a fast\-paced, high\-intensity environment.


**Professional Experience And Education**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Human Resources, Maritime Studies or a related discipline.


**Experience**
* At least five years of relevant experience in Fleet Personnel coordination, project coordination, executive support or senior administration, preferably supporting senior leadership.
* Demonstrated experience managing high\-volume email correspondence, multiple projects and concurrent deadlines in a demanding work environment.
* Experience in the maritime, ship\-management, crewing or logistics sector is preferred.
* Prior exposure to seafarer administration, CBA or union coordination, audit support, management reporting, travel, insurance, employee events or welfare programmes would be an advantage.


**Additional Requirements**
* Willingness to commit to a high\-intensity and high\-volume work environment, supported by prior experience in a role requiring sustained responsiveness and effective prioritisation.
* Availability on a 24/7 basis, when operationally necessary, to support meetings or urgent matters outside standard office hours due to Seaspan’s global operations.
* Flexibility to coordinate with stakeholders across international time zones and respond promptly to changing operational priorities.
* Ability to travel occasionally when required for Fleet Personnel forums, events or leadership support.
* Demonstrated commitment to Seaspan’s values, safety culture, confidentiality requirements and standards of professional conduct.


 Seaspan Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status. We thank all applicants in advance. If your application is shortlisted to be included in the interview process, one of our team will be in contact with you.

*

+ Provide insights to continuously improve the learning experience.


**Continuous Improvement**

title: Human Resources Intern
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – HR INTERN
 



  





 \*Company:\* Trance Interiors LLP
 



 \*Department:\* Human Resources
 



 \*Position:\* HR Intern
 



 \*Location:\* Thane West, Mumbai
 



 \*Employment Type:\* Internship
 



 \*Reporting To:\* HR Executive / HR Manager
 



  





  





  





  1\. JOB PURPOSE
 



  





 The HR Intern will support the HR Department in day\-to\-day HR operations, recruitment, employee coordination, documentation, attendance management, onboarding, employee engagement, and HR process development.
 



  





 The intern will gain practical exposure to various HR functions while assisting the HR team in maintaining an organized, professional, and employee\-friendly workplace.
 



  





  





  





  2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





  A. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition
 



  





 \* Assist in sourcing candidates through job portals, social media, references, and other recruitment channels.
 



 \* Screen CVs and shortlist candidates based on job requirements.
 



 \* Coordinate with candidates regarding interview schedules.
 



 \* Conduct initial communication with candidates.
 



 \* Maintain candidate databases and recruitment trackers.
 



 \* Follow up with candidates regarding interview attendance and joining status.
 



 \* Coordinate interview schedules with the concerned department heads.
 



 \* Maintain records of shortlisted, rejected, selected, and joined candidates.
 



 \* Assist in preparing offer letters, appointment letters, internship letters, and other HR documents.
 



  





 B. Employee Onboarding
 



  





 \* Coordinate the joining process for new employees.
 



 \* Collect and verify required employee documents.
 



 \* Maintain employee personal and employment records.
 



 \* Assist in preparing joining forms and onboarding checklists.
 



 \* Coordinate introduction of new employees to the team.
 



 \* Assist in induction and orientation programs.
 



 \* Ensure new employees are added to relevant communication groups and HR systems.
 



 \* Maintain proper onboarding documentation.
 



  





  C. Attendance \& Leave Management
 



  





 \* Maintain daily employee attendance records.
 



 \* Monitor late coming, absenteeism, leave, and early departures.
 



 \* Assist in maintaining leave records.
 



 \* Follow up with employees regarding attendance irregularities.
 



 \* Prepare attendance reports for HR review.
 



 \* Assist in monthly attendance reconciliation.
 



 \* Coordinate with employees and reporting managers regarding attendance\-related queries.
 



  





  D. Employee Records \& HR Documentation
 



  





 \* Maintain updated employee master data.
 



 \* Organize employee files and documentation.
 



 \* Maintain records of Aadhaar, PAN, educational documents, experience letters, bank details, photographs, and other required documents.
 



 \* Assist in maintaining employee joining and exit records.
 



 \* Ensure HR documents are properly filed and updated.
 



 \* Maintain confidentiality of employee information.
 



  





  E. HR Operations
 



  





 \* Assist with daily HR administrative activities.
 



 \* Prepare HR reports, trackers, and MIS.
 



 \* Maintain recruitment and employee databases.
 



 \* Assist in preparing HR communications and notices.
 



 \* Coordinate with employees and department heads for HR\-related requirements.
 



 \* Support implementation of HR policies and procedures.
 



 \* Assist in maintaining HR calendars and employee\-related schedules.
 



  





  F. Employee Engagement
 



  





 \* Assist in organizing employee engagement activities.
 



 \* Coordinate birthday celebrations, employee events, festivals, and team activities.
 



 \* Support Employee of the Month initiatives.
 



 \* Collect employee feedback where required.
 



 \* Assist in maintaining employee engagement records.
 



 \* Support initiatives to improve employee communication and workplace culture.
 



  





  G. Performance Management \& HRIS
 



  





 \* Assist in maintaining employee performance records.
 



 \* Support the HR team in collecting performance feedback from reporting managers.
 



 \* Assist in maintaining KPI and performance assessment records.
 



 \* Support the implementation of the company's HRIS / Performance Management System.
 



 \* Assist in updating employee information and HR data in the company application.
 



 \* Help maintain performance review trackers and reports.
 



 \* Support Employee of the Month evaluation processes.
 



  





  H. Learning \& Development
 



  





 \* Assist in identifying employee training requirements.
 



 \* Coordinate training sessions and workshops.
 



 \* Maintain training attendance and participation records.
 



 \* Collect employee feedback after training programs.
 



 \* Assist in preparing training calendars.
 



 \* Maintain Learning \& Development documentation.
 



  





  I. Employee Communication
 



  





 \* Draft and circulate HR\-related communications.
 



 \* Coordinate with employees through email and WhatsApp groups when required.
 



 \* Communicate interview schedules, joining instructions, HR notices, and internal announcements.
 



 \* Maintain professional communication with candidates and employees.
 



 \* Assist in resolving basic employee queries and escalate complex matters to the HR Manager.
 



  





  J. Exit \& Separation Support
 



  





 \* Assist in the employee resignation and exit process.
 



 \* Maintain resignation and exit documentation.
 



 \* Coordinate exit formalities and clearance requirements.
 



 \* Assist in collecting exit feedback.
 



 \* Update employee records after separation.
 



 \* Coordinate with relevant departments for exit\-related documentation.
 



  





  





  





  3\. DAILY HR ACTIVITIES
 



  





 The HR Intern may be responsible for:
 



  





 \* Checking attendance and leave records.
 



 \* Following up with candidates.
 



 \* Scheduling interviews.
 



 \* Updating recruitment trackers.
 



 \* Maintaining employee records.
 



 \* Coordinating with employees and reporting managers.
 



 \* Updating HRIS / HR application data.
 



 \* Preparing HR reports and documents.
 



 \* Supporting ongoing HR activities.
 



 \* Handling routine HR coordination and administrative work.
 



  





  





  





  4\. SKILLS REQUIRED
 



  





  Technical Skills
 



  





 \* Basic knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets.
 



 \* Basic knowledge of MS Word.
 



 \* Good email drafting skills.
 



 \* Basic understanding of recruitment processes.
 



 \* Ability to maintain trackers and databases.
 



 \* Basic understanding of HR functions.
 



 \* Willingness to learn HRIS and HR technology.
 



  





  Soft Skills
 



  





 \* Good verbal and written communication.
 



 \* Professional attitude.
 



 \* Good interpersonal skills.
 



 \* Ability to coordinate with multiple people.
 



 \* Attention to detail.
 



 \* Good organizational skills.
 



 \* Time management.
 



 \* Follow\-up skills.
 



 \* Positive and learning\-oriented attitude.
 



 \* Ability to maintain confidentiality.
 



  





  





  5\. EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION
 



  





 \* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, Commerce, or a related field.
 



 \* Students pursuing BBA / BMS / MBA / PGDM in HR may also be considered.
 



 \* Freshers are welcome to apply.
 



  





  





  6\. EXPERIENCE
 



  





 \*Experience:\* 0–1 year
 



  





 Freshers and candidates looking to gain practical exposure in Human Resources are encouraged to apply.
 



  





  





  7\. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)
 



  





 The HR Intern's performance may be evaluated on:
 



  





 1\. Recruitment coordination and follow\-up.
 



 2\. Interview scheduling accuracy.
 



 3\. Candidate database maintenance.
 



 4\. Employee documentation accuracy.
 



 5\. Attendance and leave record accuracy.
 



 6\. Timely completion of HR tasks.
 



 7\. Employee communication and coordination.
 



 8\. HRIS data accuracy and updates.
 



 9\. Support provided for onboarding and induction.
 



 10\. Support for employee engagement activities.
 



 11\. Report and tracker maintenance.
 



 12\. Discipline, punctuality, and attendance.
 



 13\. Confidentiality and professionalism.
 



 14\. Ability to meet assigned deadlines.
 



 15\. Learning ability and initiative.
 



  





  





  8\. CAREER DEVELOPMENT / LEARNING AREAS
 



  





 During the internship, the HR Intern will receive practical exposure to:
 



  





 \* Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition
 



 \* Interview Coordination
 



 \* Employee Onboarding
 



 \* HR Documentation
 



 \* Attendance \& Leave Management
 



 \* Employee Engagement
 



 \* HR Operations
 



 \* HRIS
 



 \* Performance Management
 



 \* KPI Management
 



 \* Learning \& Development
 



 \* Employee Relations
 



 \* HR Policies \& Procedures
 



 \* HR MIS \& Reporting
 



 \* Exit \& Separation Process
 



  





  





  9\. PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES
 



  





 The candidate should demonstrate:
 



  





 \* Professionalism
 



 \* Discipline
 



 \* Punctuality
 



 \* Ownership of assigned responsibilities
 



 \* Confidentiality
 



 \* Positive attitude
 



 \* Willingness to learn
 



 \* Accountability
 



 \* Good follow\-up
 



 \* Teamwork
 



 \* Adaptability
 



  





  





 10\. WORKING HOURS
 



  





 \*Working Hours:\* 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM
 



 \*Working Days:\* Monday to Saturday
 



  





 The employee/intern may be required to support urgent HR activities or business requirements outside normal working hours when reasonably required.
 



  





  





  11\. REPORTING \& COORDINATION
 



  





 The HR Intern will report to the \*HR Executive / HR Manager\* and will coordinate with:
 



  





 \* Management
 



 \* Department Heads
 



 \* Project Managers
 



 \* Site Supervisors
 



 \* Finance \& Accounts
 



 \* Administration
 



 \* Employees
 



 \* Job Candidates
 



  





  





  12\. CONFIDENTIALITY
 



  





 The HR Intern will have access to confidential employee and company information. All employee records, salary information, personal documents, HR reports, and internal company information must be kept strictly confidential.
 



  





 Any unauthorized sharing, copying, or disclosure of confidential information may result in appropriate disciplinary action as per company policy.
 



  





  





  13\. SUCCESS PROFILE
 



  





 A successful HR Intern at Trance Interiors LLP should be someone who is:
 



  





 \*Organized \+ Proactive \+ Communicative \+ Responsible \+ Confidential \+ Detail\-Oriented \+ Willing to Learn\*
 



  





 The intern should gradually develop the ability to independently manage routine HR activities and take ownership of assigned HR responsibilities.
 



  





  





 \*Prepared By:\* HR Department
 



 \*Company:\* Trance Interiors LLP
 


* \*Department:\* Human Resources

title: Human Resource Internship
description:
**Job Description: HR Intern
 



  





 Company Overview:
 



 Launched in 2021, Mavenwit is a Global Award\-Winning Advertising and Marketing company committed to revolutionizing the industry through innovative strategies and cutting\-edge solutions. We work with over 100\+ global brand partners and serve diverse industries by offering essential advertising and marketing services under one roof. Our mission is to 10X the growth of every business through the power of the internet. We provide services in strategy, paid media, e\-commerce, creative, commercial ads, copywriting, production, branding, and much more. Mavenwit is driven by a commitment to excellence and results.
 



  





 Internship Role: HR Intern
 



  





 Department: Talent Acquisition
 



  





 Location: Remote (Work from Anywhere)
 



 Internship Type: Remote (Flexible Timings)
 



 Stipend: Unpaid
 



 Duration: Flexible, Based on Intern's Availability
 



 Overview:
 



 As an HR Intern at Mavenwit, you will play an essential role in the Talent Acquisition process, assisting with recruitment and onboarding. You'll get hands\-on experience managing candidate databases, coordinating interviews, and supporting our HR team in talent sourcing and engagement efforts. This is an opportunity to learn HR best practices while contributing to the growth of the company.
 



 Responsibilities:
 



 Maintain and update the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) database, ensuring candidate information is accurate and up to date.
 



 Coordinate interview schedules, follow\-ups, and feedback processes between hiring managers and candidates.
 



 Engage with potential candidates through email, phone calls, and other communication channels to initiate the recruitment process.
 



 Assist in sourcing candidates through job boards, social media, and other platforms.
 



 Participate in creating and organizing interview scheduling and candidate assessments.
 



 Assist with candidate onboarding and documentation once hired.
 



 Collaborate with HR and recruitment teams to support various talent acquisition projects.
 



  





 Skills/Requirements:
 



 Basic office skills are preferred (e.g., communication, organization).
 



 Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
 



 General knowledge of Boolean search techniques and job boards is a plus.
 



 Proficient in Microsoft Excel and basic data entry.
 



 Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
 



 A proactive attitude and willingness to learn new HR tools and systems.
 



  





 Post\-Hiring Work Opportunities:
 



 After successfully completing the internship, you may be considered for potential future opportunities at Mavenwit, such as:
 



 A full\-time position in our Talent Acquisition or HR team based on performance.
 



 Opportunities to lead HR\-related projects and initiatives.
 



 A chance to work with some of the most talented professionals in the advertising industry.
 



  





 Non\-Stipend Work Perks:
 



 While the internship does not offer a stipend, there are several exciting non\-monetary benefits and perks that come with working at Mavenwit:
 



 Fully Remote Work: Work from anywhere, providing flexibility for your personal and academic life.
 



 Certification \& Skill Development: Get certified from Mavenwit and our partner companies (including HubSpot, etc.) to enhance your skills and expertise.
 



 Project Certification: Receive a certification for the projects you work on during your internship.
 



 Performance\-Based Recognition: Win prizes through exciting contests and get a chance to stand out in the global advertising industry.
 



 Networking Opportunities: Connect with industry professionals and partners through Mavenwit’s broad network.
 



 Letter of Recommendation: Earn a recommendation letter based on your performance and contribution during the internship.
 



 Growth \& Learning: Gain valuable experience working with a fast\-growing team, and expand your knowledge in HR and talent acquisition.
 



  





 Additional Information:
 



 Timings: Flexible with two working shifts to accommodate different time zones and schedules.
 



 Work Culture: Mavenwit fosters an inclusive and diverse work environment where your ideas and work will be recognized and appreciated.
 



  





 Mavenwit Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:
 



 Mavenwit is committed to fostering diversity and inclusivity in our workforce. We are an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Mavenwit does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters or agencies.
 



 If you're passionate about talent acquisition, learning new HR practices, and making an impact in a rapidly growing company, we invite you to apply!
 



  





 Apply Now!
 



 Become part of Mavenwit and build your career in HR and Talent Acquisition!**

 We are looking for an experienced and hands\-on Senior Manager – HR to lead and manage end\-to\-end Human Resources operations across the organization. The role will be responsible for ensuring effective HR processes, employee engagement, compliance, manpower planning, HR administration and smooth coordination between employees, management and business teams.

 1\. End\-to\-End HR Operations

 \* Establish standardized HR systems across locations.

 \* Handle employee queries, grievances and disciplinary issues professionally.
   

 \* Conduct employee engagement initiatives, HR meetings, awareness sessions and internal communication.
   

 \* Promote a positive and professional workplace culture.
   

 \* Support managers in handling employee\-related matters.
   

  

 7\. Performance Management
   

  

 \* Coordinate probation, confirmation, appraisal and increment processes.
   

 \* Support managers in performance discussions and documentation.
   

 \* Monitor employee performance\-related concerns and initiate appropriate HR interventions.
   

  

 8\. HRMS \& MIS
   

  

 \* Manage HRMS processes including employee master data, attendance, leave and HR documentation.
   

 \* Prepare and maintain HR MIS reports related to manpower, recruitment, attrition, attendance and other HR metrics.
   

 \* Ensure accuracy and confidentiality of employee information.
   

  

 9\. POSH \& Workplace Compliance
   

  

 \* Support implementation of POSH and workplace conduct policies.
   

 \* Conduct/coordinate employee awareness and sensitization initiatives.
   

 \* Maintain appropriate documentation and ensure concerns are handled through the prescribed process.
   

  

 10\. HR Administration \& Coordination
   

  

 \* Coordinate with administration, finance, operations and management for HR\-related requirements.
   

 \* Support employee insurance/benefits and other employee welfare activities.
   

 \* Coordinate with vendors, consultants and external agencies as required.
   

 \* Provide HR support for new outlets, hotels, projects and business expansions.
   

  

 Required Skills \& Qualifications
   

  

 \* Graduate/Postgraduate degree in HR, Human Resources Management, Business Administration or related field.
   

 \* Minimum 5 years of relevant HR experience, preferably in Hospitality, F\&B, Hotels, Retail or other multi\-location environments.
   

 \* Strong knowledge of Hospitality Recruitment, HR Operations and Generalist HR functions.
   

 \* Good understanding of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance.
   

 \* Experience in payroll, attendance and HRMS management.
   

 \* Strong recruitment and employee relations experience.
   

 \* Excellent communication, interpersonal and problem\-solving skills.
   

 \* Ability to independently manage HR operations and work closely with senior management.
   

 \* Strong documentation, coordination and organizational skills.
   

 \* Good working knowledge of MS Excel and HRMS platforms.
   

  

 Key Competencies
   

  

 \* HR Operations \& Generalist HR
   

 \* Employee Relations
   

 \* Recruitment \& Manpower Planning
   

 \* Payroll \& Attendance
   

 \* Labour Law \& Statutory Compliance
   

 \* HR Policies \& SOPs
   

 \* Performance Management
   

 \* HRMS \& MIS
   

 \* Conflict Resolution
   

 \* Employee Engagement
   

 \* Stakeholder Management
   

 \* Team Management

 A hands\-on HR professional who can independently manage day\-to\-day HR operations and recruitments, build structured HR processes, work closely with business leaders and employees, and ensure that HR practices are aligned with business requirements and organizational policies.

 We are looking for a
 **Regional Employee Relations Lead – Asia Pacific** 
 to lead BSI’s Employee Relations activity across a diverse and complex regional portfolio.
   

  

 Supporting BSI businesses across markets including China, India, Japan, Malaysia, Vietnam, Indonesia, Korea and Australia, you will provide regional leadership on complex employee relations matters while helping embed a consistent, high\-quality approach to case management, governance and employee experience.
   

  

 This is both a strategic and operational leadership role. You will oversee complex and high\-risk ER activity, advise on organisational change and restructuring, strengthen regional capability and ensure evolving employment legislation is translated into practical guidance for leaders and People teams.
   

  

 You will also lead in\-country ER Specialists across
 **China, India and Japan** 
 , while working closely with HR Generalists and Regional HR Managers across the wider APAC region.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Experience advising on organisational change, restructuring and other complex workforce matters.

**Highly Desirable**

* Broader HR Operations or People function experience within an international business.
* Professional HR qualification or relevant degree.
* Conversational or professional capability in another language used within the APAC region.

**Do you believe the world deserves excellence?**

We are a global partner for 86,000 companies and organizations in over 193 countries, offering development, auditing, certification, and training services, including innovative software solutions and cyber security expertise for all industries: from aerospace and automotive to food, construction, energy, healthcare, IT and trade sectors. * Ensure compliance with applicable employment and labour laws.
* Coordinate statutory requirements including PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS, gratuity, Shops \& Establishments, and other applicable regulations.
* Maintain required HR records and documentation.
* Coordinate internal and external audits related to HR operations and compliance.
* HRMS \& Data Management
* Own HRMS administration and ensure accurate employee master data.
* Drive automation of HR processes wherever possible.
* Monitor data accuracy, access controls, and HR reporting.
* Work with HR technology vendors for system enhancements and issue resolution.

* Act as a point of contact for employee HR\-related queries and concerns.
* Improve employee experience across onboarding, lifecycle events, and exits.
* Develop employee communication processes and HR service standards.
* Partner with HR Business Partners and business leaders on employee\-related operational matters.
* HR Governance \& Reporting
* Prepare monthly/quarterly HR MIS and dashboards.
* Track key HR metrics such as headcount, attrition, absenteeism, hiring, onboarding, exits, payroll accuracy, and employee queries.
* Identify trends and provide actionable insights to HR leadership. Maintain HR SOPs, process documentation, and audit records.


 Who you are:
   

  

* 6–10 years of experience in HR Operations, HR Shared Services, HR Generalist, or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of employee lifecycle management and HR processes.
* Good knowledge of Indian labour and statutory compliance.
* Experience managing HRMS and HR process automation.
* Strong exposure to payroll, benefits, HR MIS, and employee documentation.
* Experience working with Finance, Legal, business leaders, and external vendors.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to independently manage HR operations in a fast\-growing organization.

title: Deputy General Manager - Organisation Culture & Engagement
description:
**Job Requirements**
 About Godrej Industries Group (GIG)
   

  

 At the Godrej Industries Group, we are privileged to serve over 1\.1 billion consumers globally through our businesses with market leadership positions in the consumer products, real estate, agriculture, financial services and chemicals industries
   

  

 www.godrejindustries.com
   

  

**About Godrej Properties Limited (GPL)**
 Godrej Properties brings the Godrej Group philosophy of innovation, sustainability, and excellence to the real estate industry. Each Godrej Properties development combines the over 125\-year legacy of excellence and trust with a commitment to cutting\-edge design, technology, and sustainability.
   

  

 www.godrejproperties.com
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 The DGM — Organisation Culture \& Engagement will be the custodian of Godrej Properties' people culture — defining what it means to work here, making that real across every level of the organisation, and building an engaged workforce that drives business outcomes. This is a senior individual contributor and influencing role, working closely with the Head\-COEs, CHRO and business leadership.
   

  

 Culture Architecture \& Activation
   

  

* Define, articulate and embed the Godrej Way culture framework — values, behaviours, and ways of working — across the employee lifecycle
* Partner with business leaders to ensure culture is lived and not just stated, with visible behavioural anchors at every level
* Design and run culture diagnostics to identify gaps between desired and current culture; build action plans against findings
* Lead culture integration work during periods of organisational change, growth, or restructuring


 Employee Engagement
   

  

* Own the GPL engagement measurement strategy — design, run, and analyse engagement surveys (including Gallup, Amber or equivalent) across the organisation
* Translate engagement data into actionable insights; work with HRBPs and business heads to drive meaningful interventions at function and team level
* Build and sustain a cadence of engagement touchpoints — pulse checks, focus groups, manager\-led rituals — that keep the organisation connected and energised
* Drive recognition frameworks that reinforce culture and sustain engagement beyond survey cycles


 Manager \& Leadership Enablement
   

  

* Build capability among people managers to drive engagement within their teams — playbooks, toolkits, coaching nudges
* Partner with L\&D to embed culture and engagement into leadership development programmes
* Work with senior leaders to role\-model and cascade cultural behaviours visibly


 Measurement \& Reporting
   

  

* Own the engagement and culture scorecard; report progress to CHRO and leadership team quarterly
* Define and track MOPs: engagement scores, manager effectiveness, culture index


 Who are we looking for?
   

  

* 2019\-2021 batch passout from premier b\-schools
* Demonstrated experience running large\-scale engagement programmes (Gallup Q12 preferred)
* Strong diagnostic ability — comfortable with data, surveys, and translating numbers into people insights
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills — this role works across levels without direct authority
* Strong written and verbal communication — able to build narratives, write well, present confidently
* Experience in real estate, infrastructure, or similarly project\-driven, distributed organisations is a plus


 What Success Looks Like in Year One
   

  

* Engagement score improvement to 85th percentile for the BU
* Engagement survey completed, results socialised, and function\-level action plans live
* Culture framework documented and activated with visible behavioural markers
* Manager enablement toolkit deployed


**Work Experience**
 6–8 years
   

  

**Benefits**
 What’s in it for you?
   

  

 Be an equal parent
   

  

*Maternity support, including paid leave ahead of statutory guidelines, and flexible work options on return*
*Paternity support, including paid leave*
*New mothers can bring a caregiver and children under a year old, on work travel*
*Adoption support; gender neutral and based on the primary caregiver, with paid leave options*
 No place for discrimination at Godrej
   

  

*Gender\-neutral anti\-harassment policy*
*Same sex partner benefits at par with married spouses*
*Gender transition support*
 We are selfish about your wellness
   

  

*Comprehensive health insurance plans, as well as accident coverage for you and your family, with top\-up options*
*Trust based sick leave*
*Mental wellness and self\-care programmes, resources and counselling*
 Celebrating wins, the Godrej Way
   

  

*Structured recognition platforms for individual, team and business\-level achievements*
*Performance\-based earning opportunities*
 https://www.godrejcareers.com/benefits/
   

  

 An inclusive Godrej
   

  

 Before you go, there is something important we want to highlight. There is no place for discrimination at Godrej. Diversity is the philosophy of who we are as a company. And has been for over a century. It’s not just in our DNA and nice to do. Being more diverse \- especially having our team members reflect the diversity of our businesses and communities \- helps us innovate better and grow faster. We hope this resonates with you.
   

  

 We take pride in being an equal opportunities employer. We recognise merit and encourage diversity. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination on the basis of nationality, race, colour, religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, or marital status and ensure equal opportunities for all our team members.
   

  

 If this sounds like a role for you, apply now! We look forward to meeting you.
