* Works closely with the Fleet Cell and Marine HR to ensure service delivery as per customer contracts.
* Functions as the escalation point for all crew\-related matters, collaborating with Fleet Managers and Crewing Operations to resolve issues.
* Ensures that Crew Management delivers on KPIs agreed upon between client, Fleet Cells, and Crew Management, including budget ownership for crew operations.
* Ensures the diligent usage of ShipSure as the system of record for all crewing activities and drives it with other teams for their crew and vessels.


**Crew Planning \& Workforce Management**
* Responsible for crew engagement and crew welfare.
* Maintains an effective crew rotation plan for assigned vessels, ensuring consistency with global planning principles and as guided by Global Pool Managers.
* Identifies candidates for vacancies using fleet crew pools and recruitment when needed. Escalates critical vacancies to RCMP and Global Pool Manager when necessary.
* Works proactively and as guided by the Global Pool Manager to maintain and balance crew pool strength, including managing crew surpluses and reallocations.
* Supports fleet takeovers by identifying suitable seafarers for vessel transition.
* Works closely with the Global Pool Manager and supports building career progression plans for seafarers and ensures performance monitoring through appraisals.
* Identifies and addresses crew retention risks by working with key stakeholders


**Budget Management \& Operational Efficiency**
* Owns and manages the Vessel budget, including annual renewals, negotiation with customers and reporting.
* Owns and manage budget preparation by providing insights on wages, benefits, and crewing costs in collaboration with the P\&L team.
* Schedules and reports on service performance and budget reviews, recommending actions to support continuous improvement.


**Compliance, Industrial Relations \& HSSEQ Support**
* Ensures compliance with maritime regulations, flag state requirements, and industrial relations for assigned fleets.
* Manages urgent crew changes and vacancies through the effective utilization of the V.Ships seafarer pool.
* Assists HSSEQ in accident investigations related to crewing and supports the implementation of corrective/preventive actions.
* Drive data quality and comply with Quality Assurance process (Audit)


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Process Improvement**
* Participate in the new business proposal preparation and review as well as new business onboarding process.
* Collaborates proactively with internal and external stakeholders, including seafarers to ensure outstanding service delivery.
* Be familiar with and promote V.Group and Marine HR services and initiatives.
* Provides feedback on ShipSure enhancements and other crewing process improvements.
* Works digitally with V.Crew Connect, ShipSure BI, and other digital tools to streamline operations.
* Delivers client reports, ensuring transparency and data\-driven insights into seafarer management and operational performance.


**What can I expect in return?** 
 V. Group can offer you a market leading salary and benefits package, in addition to significant opportunities for career growth and personal development. This a great opportunity to join a true leader in the maritime sector \- a company that has exciting plans for future growth.
   

  

**Essential**
* Maritime or shipping industry experience
* Knowledge of crew operations, planning, and workforce management.
* Proven customer service mindset and ability to build strong relationships with stakeholders.
* Excellent organizational, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong collaboration and influencing skills to drive change and improvement.
* Ability to manage budgets, reports, and performance KPIs effectively.
* Excellent communication skills, with an ability to negotiate and resolve conflicts effectively.
* Good technology and data analysis proficiency.


**Desirable**
* Proficiency in ShipSure and planning tools functionality.
* Multinational work experience

title: Deputy General Manager - Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
description:
**Job Requirements**
 About Godrej Industries Group (GIG)
   

  

 At the Godrej Industries Group, we are privileged to serve over 1\.1 billion consumers globally through our businesses with market leadership positions in the consumer products, real estate, agriculture, financial services and chemicals industries
   

  

 www.godrejindustries.com
   

  

**About Godrej Properties Limited (GPL)**
 Godrej Properties brings the Godrej Group philosophy of innovation, sustainability, and excellence to the real estate industry. Each Godrej Properties development combines the over 125\-year legacy of excellence and trust with a commitment to cutting\-edge design, technology, and sustainability.
   

  

 www.godrejproperties.com
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 The DGM — DEI will build and lead Godrej Properties' diversity, equity and inclusion agenda — moving it from intent to measurable impact. This role is responsible for designing the DEI strategy, embedding it across talent processes, driving representation goals, and building an inclusive culture where every employee can do their best work. The role reports to the Head COEs and works closely with business and HR leadership.
   

  

 Strategy \& Roadmap
   

  

* Design and own the GPL DEI strategy — short and long\-term roadmap with clear goals, interventions, and measurable outcomes
* Conduct a DEI diagnostic across the organisation — representation data, pay equity, inclusion sentiment, policy gaps — to establish baseline and priorities
* Benchmark GPL's DEI position against real estate sector peers and identify aspiration gaps


 Representation \& Hiring
   

  

* Partner with Talent Acquisition to embed DEI into sourcing, screening, and selection — diverse slates, structured interviews, bias mitigation
* Set and track representation targets across gender, differently\-abled, LGBTQ\+, and other dimensions across levels and functions
* Build pipelines for underrepresented groups — campus partnerships, return\-to\-work programmes, industry collaboration


 Inclusion \& Equity
   

  

* Audit and improve people processes — performance, promotions, pay, development — for equity and bias
* Design and run inclusion interventions — safe spaces, employee resource groups (ERGs), allyship programmes, inclusive leadership development
* Ensure policies (maternity, paternity, POSH, flexible work) are not just compliant but genuinely inclusive in spirit and practice


 Culture \& Capability
   

  

* Build DEI awareness and capability across the organisation — workshops, toolkits, leader conversations, manager nudges
* Partner with L\&D to embed inclusive leadership into all people manager and leadership programmes
* Drive visible DEI moments through the internal communications calendar — days of significance, storytelling, recognition


 Measurement \& Reporting
   

  

* Own the DEI scorecard — representation metrics, inclusion index, pay equity data — reported to leadership and Board as applicable
* Track progress rigorously and course\-correct with data


 Who are we looking for?
   

  

* Batch of 2019\-2021 from premier b\-schools
* Strong understanding of the Indian DEI landscape — gender, disability, LGBTQ\+, generational diversity — and what works in practice, not just in theory
* Experience designing and running DEI programmes at scale in complex organisations
* Data fluency — comfortable building representation dashboards, analysing pay equity, and presenting insights to leadership
* Excellent influencing and communication skills — able to build conviction without mandate
* Knowledge of POSH, statutory compliance, and relevant Indian regulatory context
* Real estate or infrastructure sector experience preferred; large, multi\-site, blue\-collar\-inclusive organisations a strong plus


 What Success Looks Like in Year One
   

  

* Representation targets set and tracking live across gender, lgbtq\+, PWD
* At least one ERG or structured inclusion programme launched and active
* DEI embedded into at least two core talent processes (hiring, performance, or promotions)
* Inclusion sentiment score established as a baseline for future measurement


**Work Experience**
 6–8 years
   

  

**Benefits**
 What’s in it for you?
   

  

 Be an equal parent
   

  

*Maternity support, including paid leave ahead of statutory guidelines, and flexible work options on return*
*Paternity support, including paid leave*
*New mothers can bring a caregiver and children under a year old, on work travel*
*Adoption support; gender neutral and based on the primary caregiver, with paid leave options*
 No place for discrimination at Godrej
   

  

*Gender\-neutral anti\-harassment policy*
*Same sex partner benefits at par with married spouses*
*Gender transition support*
 We are selfish about your wellness
   

  

*Comprehensive health insurance plans, as well as accident coverage for you and your family, with top\-up options*
*Trust based sick leave*
*Mental wellness and self\-care programmes, resources and counselling*
 Celebrating wins, the Godrej Way
   

  

*Structured recognition platforms for individual, team and business\-level achievements*
*Performance\-based earning opportunities*
 https://www.godrejcareers.com/benefits/
   

  

 An inclusive Godrej
   

  

 Before you go, there is something important we want to highlight. There is no place for discrimination at Godrej. Diversity is the philosophy of who we are as a company. And has been for over a century. It’s not just in our DNA and nice to do. Being more diverse \- especially having our team members reflect the diversity of our businesses and communities \- helps us innovate better and grow faster. We hope this resonates with you.
   

  

 We take pride in being an equal opportunities employer. We recognise merit and encourage diversity. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination on the basis of nationality, race, colour, religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, or marital status and ensure equal opportunities for all our team members.
   

  

 If this sounds like a role for you, apply now! We look forward to meeting you.

title: Senior Executive Human Resources
description:
**About Expenzing** 


 Expenzing is India’s leading spend management software company, helping finance teams achieve compliance, spend control, faster cycle times, and higher productivity. Our suite covers Accounts Payable Automation, Travel \& Employee Expenses, Vendor Portals, Procure\-to\-Pay, Budgeting, RFPs, and Fixed Asset Management—ensuring a seamless employee experience with strong financial governance.
 




  




**Role Overview** 


 We are looking for a proactive and enthusiastic Senior Executive Human Resource with 3\+ years of experience to join us. The role offers hands\-on exposure to various facets of Human Resources including recruitment, payroll, onboarding, administration, and employee engagement.
 




  




**Key Responsibilities** 
* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment process including sourcing, screening, scheduling interviews, and onboarding candidates.
* Coordinate with department heads to understand hiring requirements and manpower planning.
* Handle employee onboarding, induction, documentation, and exit formalities.
* Process monthly payroll inputs including attendance, leaves, incentives, deductions, and reimbursements.
* Maintain employee records, HR databases, and confidential personnel files.
* Ensure compliance with labor laws, statutory regulations, and company HR policies.
* Coordinate statutory activities related to PF, ESIC, gratuity, bonus, and other compliance requirements.
* Address employee queries related to HR policies, payroll, attendance, and benefits.
* Plan and execute employee engagement activities, celebrations, wellness initiatives, and team\-building programs.
* Support performance management processes including appraisals, feedback, and employee development initiatives.
* Prepare HR reports, MIS, attendance records, and recruitment status updates.
* Assist in drafting HR letters, policies, contracts, and official communications.
* Coordinate daily administrative activities including office management, vendor coordination, and employee support.



  




**Desired Skills \& Qualities** 
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good organizational and time management abilities.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information.
* Eagerness to build a career in Human Resources.



  




**Qualification** 
* Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or related field.
